# SZLHOLDINGS/szl-receiptagent-qwen35-0.8b-v3 This is a separate research bf16 LoRA adapter (r=16, alpha=32) on `Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B`, trained with Unsloth on a laptop Blackwell GPU, with a derived merged artifact also present in the repository. "Placeholder" describes release status, not absence of weights.
